The State of Maharashtra ..Respondent
18:32:23 +0530
 Mr. Satyavrat Joshi i/by Mr. Jaydeep Mane for the Applicant.
 Mr. S. H. Yadav, App for the State.
 Mr. Mali D.P., Asi, Kurduwadi Police Station - present.
 Coram : M. S. Karnik, J.
 Date : February 21, 2023
 P.C. :
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned APP for the State.

2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail in respect of the offence punishable under Sections 416,
417, 419, 420, 467, 468 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 in connection with C.R. No.208 of 2022 dated 30/04/2022 registered with Kurduwadi Police Station.

3. It is the allegation that the accused no.1 on the basis of bogus disability certificate dated 22/07/2011 obtained in respect of his daughter-Vaibhav Babusaheb Anantkavlas has Tauseef 905.aba.3359-22.doc taken various benefits in respect of his employment, transfer, etc.
Pursuant to the complaint, it was revealed that the daughter named in the disability certificate was born to the accused no.1 sometime in the year 2012.
The daughter is not suffering from any disability.

It is Ashok Rupchand Mehata vs State Of Maharashtra on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4646293/
1 shown to have been issued one year, prior to her birth.

entities.text: Ashok Rupchand Mehata vs State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant at the relevant time was working as medical superintendent with the General Hospital, Solapur.
He is not the one who has certified the disability, but the certificate bears his signature as a counter signatory.
The Applicant is 69 years of age and has retired from service.
The original certificate is already with the investigating agency.
The applicant is willing to co- operate and also ready to offer his specific signatures.
In this view of the matter, the applicant can be protected by an interim order.
4. In the meantime, in the event of his arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing P.R. Bond of Rs.15,000/- with one or more sureties in the like amount.

5. The applicant shall report to the concerned police station on 25/02/2023 and 26/02/2023 between 11.00 a.m. Tauseef 905.aba.3359-22.doc and 1.00 p.m. and co-operate with the investigation as and when called.
6. Stand over to 06/03/2023.

(M. S. KARNIK, J.)
